tools.name: lumi_list_accounts
tools.description: List connected social accounts in the API key's Lumi workspace (public metadata only).

tools.name: lumi_upload_media
tools.description: Upload a local image or video file to Lumi's workspace media library (SHA-256 deduplicated within the workspace).

tools.name: lumi_create_post
tools.description: Propose a new post in waiting state (approval-first: nothing publishes until explicitly approved).

tools.name: lumi_list_posts
tools.description: List posts in the workspace, optionally filtered by state or label.

tools.name: lumi_schedule_calendar
tools.description: Get scheduled and proposed posts from the workspace calendar, optionally bounded by from/to timestamps.

tools.name: lumi_approve_post
tools.description: Explicitly approve a waiting post at its exact version for publishing.

tools.name: lumi_get_post
tools.description: Get full status and per-account delivery results for a single post.

tools.name: lumi_retry_post
tools.description: Retry failed or uncertain deliveries on a post (all failed targets or one account_id).

tools.name: lumi_cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel / set aside a waiting post (moves it to kept state).

tools.name: lumi_analytics_overview
tools.description: Workspace telemetry overview: connected account follower/view counts, deltas, 24h publish health, and YouTube daily quota remaining.

tools.name: lumi_post_metrics
tools.description: Get post milestone metric snapshots (+1h/+24h/+72h/+7d) across its deliveries; pass refresh=true to pull live review-safe stats now.

tools.name: lumi_account_metrics
tools.description: Get account metric time series (followers, posts, total views, reconnect health); pass refresh=true to pull a fresh snapshot.

tools.name: lumi_list_webhooks
tools.description: List HMAC-SHA256 signed webhook endpoints in the workspace (requires webhooks:manage scope).

tools.name: lumi_create_webhook
tools.description: Register a public HTTPS HMAC-SHA256 webhook endpoint (requires webhooks:manage scope). Returns the signing secret once.

tools.name: lumi_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete an active webhook endpoint by id (requires webhooks:manage scope).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "lumi_create_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register a public HTTPS HMAC-SHA256 webhook endpoint (requires webhooks:manage scope). Returns the signing secret once.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lumi_list_posts, lumi_schedule_calendar, lumi_get_post, lumi_post_metrics, lumi_account_metrics · Private data: lumi_list_accounts, lumi_upload_media, lumi_create_webhook · Public sink: lumi_upload_media, lumi_create_post, lumi_approve_post, lumi_get_post, lumi_retry_post, lumi_cancel_post, lumi_analytics_overview, lumi_post_metrics, lumi_list_webhooks, lumi_create_webhook, lumi_delete_webhook · Destructive: lumi_delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lumi_list_posts, lumi_schedule_calendar, lumi_get_post, lumi_post_metrics, lumi_account_metrics · Private data: lumi_list_accounts, lumi_upload_media, lumi_create_webhook · Public sink: lumi_upload_media, lumi_create_post, lumi_approve_post, lumi_get_post, lumi_retry_post, lumi_cancel_post, lumi_analytics_overview, lumi_post_metrics, lumi_list_webhooks, lumi_create_webhook, lumi_delete_webhook · Destructive: lumi_delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
